original: CAUTION: cancer cells that multiply really fast can grab glutamine too, to fuel their growth. So if you have an active colon or liver cancer, don't raise the dose that high. The liver is on that list because the blood from your gut goes straight there, through the portal vein, so a big dose of glutamine reaches your liver before anywhere else.
rewrite: CAUTION: cancer cells that multiply really fast can grab glutamine too, to fuel their growth, so if you have an active colon or liver cancer, don't go up to the 10-30g. A dose that big is more than your gut cells can use, and the rest rides the portal vein from your gut straight to your liver, so the liver gets it first, while it's still concentrated.
